entries.source: As unpleasant-looking as any exposed organ.
entries.target: 和任何外露的器官一样难看。

entries.source: With blinding speed you suddenly appear next to a target up to %d spaces away and attack for %d%% damage.
entries.target: 你以难以置信的速度闪现至附近 %d 码的一个目标身边并造成 %d%% 伤害。

entries.source:
The pedestal seems to react to something in your bag. After some tests you notice it is the %s.
Do you wish to use the orb on the pedestal?
entries.target:
这个基座似乎对你包里的东西有反应。经过测试后，你发现是包里的%s.
你想在这个基座上使用这个水晶球吗？
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 力量，+3 敏捷，+0 体质

entries.source: This talent cannot be used here.
entries.target: 该技能不能在此处使用。

entries.source: An orc clad in massive armour, wielding a huge axe.
entries.target: 一只身穿板甲的兽人，手里握着一把巨斧。
暴击时 物理溅射伤害

entries.source: Space around you starts to dissolve...
entries.target: 你周围的空间开始消解...

entries.source: I'm already proficient, but I want to be an expert (improves talent mastery by 0.2) - 750 gold.
entries.target: 我已经熟练掌握了，但我想成为一名专家。(增加技能树系数0.2) - 750 金币。

entries.source: A towering creature, made from the bones of hundreds of dead bodies. It is covered by an unholy aura.
entries.target: 一个高大的生物，由数百具尸体的骨头构成。它全身围绕着邪恶的气息。

entries.source: An invocation portal, perpetually summoning beings through it.
entries.target: 一个仪式传送门，不断地从另一边召唤生物。

entries.source:
#ORANGE# Create Object: Unable to load all objects from file %s:#GREY#
 %s
entries.target:
#ORANGE# 创建物品：无法读取文件%s的所有物品:#GREY#
 %s

entries.source: A creature stands before you, with long tentacle-like appendages and a squat bump in place of a head. An intense aura of power radiates from this being unlike anything you've ever felt before. It can only be a Sher'Tul. A living Sher'Tul!
entries.target: 四肢是触须，头部由某种突起代替的奇怪生物。一种强烈的能量在他周围流动，这股能量不同于你之前认识的任何一种。他只能是夏·图尔人。一名活生生的夏·图尔人！
你现在不能使用该技能。
马基·埃亚尔的传说手札

entries.source: #Source# strikes at a vital spot on #target#!
A strange blob on the dungeon floor.
entries.target: 地板上的一团奇怪胶状物体。

entries.source: Tiny, dark grey, and wickedly sharp. It looks more like rock than bone.
entries.target: 它小巧、暗灰且锋利得吓人。它看起来更像石头而不是骨头。

entries.source: You can't cast this on friendly targets.
entries.target: 该技能不能对友军释放。

entries.source: It is a cross between a human and a bull.
entries.target: 它拥有人类和牛的特征。

entries.source: You do not have enough ammo left!
A length of troll intestines. Fortunately, the troll appears to have eaten nothing in some time.
entries.target: 一截巨魔肠子。幸运的是，这只巨魔似乎已经有一段时间没吃东西了。
